title: [AdvancedPaste] Add "Paste as .jpg file" action with configurable JPEG quality

proposed_comments.title: Do not advertise a disabled JPEG shortcut

confidence.rationale: The current append is reachable with the parent shown and the JPEG child disabled; the action enablement filter checks both flags.

proposed_comments.title: Preserve the existing paste-format telemetry values
proposed_comments.body:
### Preserve the existing paste-format telemetry values

**Severity:** `medium`

Inserting this implicit enum member changes HTML from 7 to 8, MP3 from 8 to 9, MP4 from 9 to 10, KernelQuery from 10 to 11, and CustomTextTransformation from 11 to 12. `PasteFormatExecutor.WriteTelemetry` sends this enum through the existing format-click and in-app-shortcut EventSource payloads, so the same numeric identifiers acquire different meanings across versions.

Assign JPEG the unused value 12 and explicitly preserve HTML=7, MP3=8, MP4=9, KernelQuery=10, and CustomTextTransformation=11 in `PasteFormats.cs`. Setting only JPEG=12 is not sufficient: the following implicit HTML member would then become 13. Add an enum-value regression assertion and verify both existing action telemetry and the new JPEG action; no new telemetry event or generic telemetry-process follow-up is needed for this fix.

confidence.rationale: The pinned enum and actual telemetry callers establish numeric renumbering; runtime enum assertions fail upstream and pass with the preserved assignments.

proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The required native placeholder and ordered traversal are in unchanged dllmain.cpp; the current diff adds only the managed JPEG child and does not modify this native function.

confidence.rationale: Raw legacy JSON has no JPEG slot while the managed backing-field initializer supplies one; the positional-ID conflict consumer is explicit.
